answers.answer: MX = 5 (radius), MY = MZ + ZY = 5 + 8 = 13. Since $MX^2 + XY^2 = 25 + 144 = 169 = MY^2$, triangle MXY is right-angled at X, so MX ⊥ XY at X on the circle; hence line XY is a tangent to circle M at X.
MN = 13 = r1 + r2, so the two circles are touching externally.
MN = 5 = r1 - r2, so the two circles are touching internally.
MN = 3 < r1 - r2 = 5, so circle N lies inside circle M (no common points, not concentric).
MN = 0, so the two circles are concentric (N inside M).
r1 - r2 = 5 < MN = 10 < r1 + r2 = 13, so the two circles are intersecting at two points.
MN = 15 > r1 + r2 = 13, so the two circles are distant (outside each other).
